simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תְּלִי (H8522) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: תְּלִי (tᵉlîy) means a quiver (as slung) First listed occurrence: Gen 27 3.

definitions.full: H8522. teli [ תְּלִי ] noun [masculine] quiver (with its arrows) (as hanging from shoulder); — suffix וְקֵשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ תֶּלְיְךָ Gen 27:3 (J; ᵐ5 φαρέτρα , ᵑ9 pharetra ). תִּלָּהּ see תֵּל infra.
